card.name: Inside transliterated Sh- names
card.fires_on: The second piece of a name or foreign term transliterated with Sh- or Su-, such as Shu'ara, Shura, Shangshung, Shun. It fires after the opening Sh/Sch part.

modes.label: Arabic terms
modes.description: Ending of Arabic transliterations like Shu'ara and Shura.

modes.label: Other Sh- names
modes.description: Middle or end of personal and place names beginning with Sh, from Tibetan, Chinese or other languages.

card.plain: It fires partway through foreign names and terms that start with Sh, mostly Arabic and Tibetan transliterations.
